alerts.title: No FBS/RBS monitoring on DTG
alerts.message: Guidelines list FBS/RBS as a required laboratory test, especially for adults at risk on DTG. The patient is on DTG but has no blood glucose monitoring recorded. The clinician's plan does not include any glucose testing. While the patient has no reported symptoms of hyperglycemia, routine screening is recommended per guidelines to detect asymptomatic drug-related metabolic effects.

evidence.recommended_action: Order FBS/RBS as part of routine monitoring for this patient on DTG, per guideline laboratory schedule.

alerts.title: No LFTs monitoring recorded
alerts.message: Guidelines include LFTs in the scheduled laboratory tests for patients on ART. No liver function tests are recorded for this patient on TDF/3TC/DTG since 2022. The clinician's plan does not address LFT monitoring. TDF and DTG can both affect hepatic function, and routine LFT screening helps detect early drug-related hepatotoxicity before symptomatic disease develops.

evidence.recommended_action: Order baseline and periodic LFTs as part of routine laboratory monitoring per guideline schedule.

alerts.title: No HBsAg screening recorded
alerts.message: Guidelines list HBsAg as a required laboratory test for patients on ART. No HBsAg result is recorded for this patient on TDF/3TC since 2022. TDF and 3TC are active against hepatitis B virus; knowing HBsAg status is important because discontinuation of TDF/3TC in co-infected patients risks HBV flare. The clinician's plan does not address HBV screening.

evidence.recommended_action: Order HBsAg test if not previously done, to identify HBV co-infection requiring continued TDF/3TC.
